note: GeoOrigin with rotateYUp turns the geographic points into metres around the origin: lon 0.00002 degrees = 2.22639 m east, height 2 m = 2 m up, so the quad is 2.226 wide and 2 tall (x 0 to 2.226 in the picture around a camera at x 1.113). Moving geoCoords by 0.00001 degrees (1.113 m east) slides the quad 1.113 m back in the same timestamp; setting it back restores the picture.
gaps: only GD and UTM and GC geoSystems with the WE and IN style ellipsoids are exercised in the unit checks of BR.geo; the picture tests use GD WE
a plain list handed to a double field of X_ITE 16.6.0 (a harness slip, now converted to SFVec3d) turns the picture to nothing and a second set kills the page
the origin is read at use: a change of geoSystem of an existing GeoOrigin at run time is not tested (the field is initializeOnly)
